SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity"::INTEGER >= 200
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');

SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'cafe'
    AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" != 'cafe'
    OR r."food_service" IS NULL;

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_id",
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" iss ON its."id" = iss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON iss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_id";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        it_support_specialists_systems itss
    JOIN
        systems s ON itss.system_id = s.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
ORDER BY
    j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
263:
SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software engineer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."description") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."description") LIKE '%software engineer%';

SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
266:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "minimum_years",
        "preferred_years",
        "jobtitle"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    msj."jobtitle" AS "position",
    msj."minimum_years" AS "minimum_experience_years",
    msj."preferred_years" AS "preferred_experience_years"
FROM
    max_salary_job msj;
